title: Solving a 31-year-old grand challenge in mathematics – the KLS conjecture - Microsoft Research
gist: Microsoft Research's Xinzhi Zhang and a collaborator proved the 31-year-old KLS conjecture in high-dimensional geometry, showing a dimension-independent bound, with independent parallel proofs and a Lean 4 formalization confirming it. The proof came from a human-directed agentic AI process of roughly 100 explored trajectories, while unguided attempts by leading models with a similar token budget failed.

insights.claim: Researchers including Microsoft Research's Xinzhi Zhang proved the Kannan-Lovász-Simonovits (KLS) conjecture, a 31-year-old open problem in high-dimensional geometry, showing a dimension-independent constant bound.
